BatchVerifyPentestVuln.description_en: Submits asynchronous retests in bulk for specified vulnerabilities under the current account and returns the acceptance results for each item
BatchVerifyPentestVuln.description_zh: 为当前账号下指定的漏洞批量提交异步复测，返回逐项受理结果

CreatePentestTask.description_en: Creates penetration testing tasks for authorized assets of the current account and returns the task IDs. You can specify up to five targets at a time, and one task is created for each target
CreatePentestTask.description_zh: 为当前账号的已授权资产创建渗透测试任务，返回任务 ID；一次最多指定 5 个目标，每个目标创建一个任务

DescribePentestReportContent.description_en: Queries the PDF report of a specified penetration test task for the current account, and returns a temporary Object Storage Service (OSS) download URL and the expiration time without returning the report content
DescribePentestReportContent.description_zh: 查询当前账号指定渗透测试任务的 PDF 报告，返回 OSS 临时下载链接及过期时间，不返回报告正文

DescribePentestTaskList.description_en: Queries the penetration testing nodes of the current account by paging and returns the node status, execution duration, Credits usage, time, and vulnerability statistics
DescribePentestTaskList.description_zh: 分页查询当前账号的渗透测试任务，返回任务状态、执行耗时、Credits 用量、时间及漏洞统计信息

DescribePentestVulnDetail.description_en: Queries the details of a single vulnerability under the current account without triggering a scan or vulnerability verification
DescribePentestVulnDetail.description_zh: 查询当前账号下单个漏洞的详细信息，不触发扫描或漏洞验证

DescribePentestVulnList.description_en: Queries the penetration testing vulnerabilities of the current account by task ID with pagination. Returns information such as the vulnerability title, severity, authentication status, affected URLs, and discovery time, and supports filtering by severity
DescribePentestVulnList.description_zh: 按任务 ID 分页查询当前账号的渗透测试漏洞，返回漏洞标题、严重程度、验证状态、受影响地址和发现时间等信息，支持按严重程度过滤
